But I still miss the countryside.
directions: A tourist stopped me in the street.
"Excuse me, which way is the station?"
"It's not far. Go straight and turn left."
"Thank you for the directions!" he said.
countries1: My family lives all over the world.
My daughter studies in the UK.
My sister married a man from France.
They often travel to Italy and Spain.
But my home is in China.
countries2: My wife and I want to see the world.
First, we want to see the pyramids in Egypt.
Then we want to see the mountains in Switzerland.
In spring, the flowers in the Netherlands are beautiful.
In winter, we can see the northern lights in Norway.
We also want to visit the islands of Greece.
Our neighbor says Vietnam is cheap and the food is good.
countries3: My grandson wants to travel when he grows up.
He wants to climb mountains in Nepal.
He wants to ride a horse in Mongolia.
He wants to see Angkor Wat in Cambodia.
He wants to see the lions in Kenya.
He wants to visit Machu Picchu in Peru.
And he wants to eat chocolate in Belgium!
nationalities1: At our English corner, people come from many countries.
nationalities2: My grandson studies at an international school.
weather: The weather has been strange this week.
On Monday, it was sunny and warm.
On Tuesday, it was cloudy and windy.
On Wednesday, there was a big storm.
On Thursday, it was very foggy.
On Friday, we saw a rainbow!
climate: Our community wants to protect the environment.
Every family has to sort the trash.
I take a reusable bag to the market.
In winter, the smog is bad.
Global warming is a big problem for our grandchildren.
rocks: For my birthday, my husband gave me a gift.
My daughter wears a pearl necklace.
My grandson collects every pebble from the river.
Once, he found a fossil of a small fish!
Our kitchen table is made of marble.
naturalhistory: I took my grandson to the natural history museum.
In the big hall, there was a huge dinosaur.
Look at its long tail and sharp claws!
In the next room, we saw a mammoth from the Ice Age.
We also saw a dinosaur footprint in stone.
mammals1: On Sunday, we took the grandchildren to the zoo.
First, we saw the pandas eating bamboo.
The giraffe had a very long neck.
The elephant was washing itself with water.
The monkeys were jumping and playing.
The lion was sleeping in the sun.
The kangaroo was carrying a baby!
mammals2: Behind our house, there is a small wood.
In the morning, a squirrel runs up the tree.
At night, a hedgehog comes to our garden.
A bat flies around the street lamp.
A mouse lives under the shed.
My grandson says, "I want to see a red panda!"
birds1: Every morning, I walk in the park and listen to the birds.
A sparrow is looking for food.
A magpie is sitting on the wall.
In China, the magpie brings good news.
A woodpecker is knocking on a tree.
There is a nest in the tree, with baby birds.
On the lake, a white swan swims slowly.
birds2: In spring, many birds come back from the south.
A swallow built a nest under our roof.
By the river, a heron stands very still.
A blue kingfisher dives for fish.
In the wetland, we saw a red-crowned crane.
High in the sky, a hawk is flying.
insects: In summer, my granddaughter plays in the garden.
A bee is visiting the flowers.
A red ladybug is on a leaf.
A green caterpillar is eating the leaf.
A dragonfly flies over the pond.
In the evening, a mosquito bites her arm!
reptiles: There is a small pond in our park.
In spring, there are many tadpoles in the water.
An old turtle sits on a rock in the sun.
My grandson saw a snake in the grass!
But it was only a small lizard.
pets: Last month, we got a puppy for the family.
Every morning, I walk the dog in the park.
I feed him twice a day.
We buy pet food at the supermarket.
The cat is not happy about the new pet!
My granddaughter also has a goldfish.
farmanimals: When I was young, I lived on a farm.
Every morning, the rooster woke us up.
I collected eggs from the hens.
The sheepdog looked after the sheep.
We used a donkey to carry things.
ocean: We took the grandchildren to the aquarium.
In a big tank, a shark swam past us.
We saw colorful coral and tropical fish.
An octopus was hiding in a rock.
The jellyfish looked like little lamps.
Then we watched the dolphins jump.
A sea lion clapped its flippers!
trees1: In our park, there is a very old tree.
It is a ginkgo, more than three hundred years old.
Its tree trunk is very thick.
Its roots are deep in the ground.
In autumn, its fallen leaves are golden.
Children love to sit under its big branches.
trees2: My wife grows flowers on our balcony.
In spring, a small bud appears.
A week later, the flowers bloom.
Each petal is soft and pink.
Be careful of the thorns on the roses!
She also grows a lotus in a big pot.
A green vine climbs up the wall.
trees3: Every season, our park has different colors.
In winter, the plum blossom opens in the snow.
In spring, the azaleas are red and pink.
In summer, white jasmine smells sweet.
In autumn, the osmanthus fills the air.
The tall birch trees turn yellow.
My grandson collects pine cones on the ground.
fungi: After the rain, Grandma and I go to the forest.
Grandma knows which ones are edible.
"Never eat that red one. It's poisonous!"
We also find some wood ear on an old tree.
At home, she cooks soup with shiitake.
time: I wake up early every day.
I get up at six o'clock.
In the morning, I do tai chi in the park.
At noon, I have lunch with my wife.
In the afternoon, I take a nap for one hour.
At half past seven, we watch the news.
I never go to bed late.
calendar: On Monday, I see the doctor.
On Wednesday, I go to my calligraphy class.
On Friday, I visit my sister.
At the weekend, my grandchildren come to stay.

numbers: I went to the bank to open an account.
The clerk said, "Please write your phone number."

I counted one thousand yuan, and it was right.
measures: At the market, I buy vegetables every morning.
The seller puts them on the scale.
The bag of noodles is light.
I also buy a liter of milk.
My home is only one kilometer away, so I walk.
writing: At the hospital, I have to fill in a form.
"Please fill in this form," says the nurse.
Then I write my date of birth.
She says, "Please use a capital letter for your name."
At the bottom, I write my signature.
describe1: My granddaughter helps me clean the house.
After we mop it, it is wet.
An hour later, it is dry and clean.
Now the fridge is empty, so we go shopping.
describe2: My grandson and I are painting a picture.
The sun is yellow and round.
The house has a red roof.
phrasal: This morning, I was in a hurry.
I had to look for my glasses everywhere.
My wife said, "Calm down! They are on your head!"
I had to pick up my grandson from school.

expr1: A new neighbor moved in next door.
"Nice to meet you. I'm Mr. Wang."
I gave her some dumplings. "Thank you!" she said.
expr2: A foreign tourist asked me for help in the street.
He spoke very fast. "Pardon?" I said.

"It's the old temple. Let's go! I'll show you."
